items.source:
SPI to customize which property of an entity is used as unique identifier and how the entity instance is looked up
from the backend.
items.translation: 使用 SPI 来自定义实体的哪个属性用作唯一标识符，以及后端如何查找该实体实例。

items.source: Component to create self links for entity instances.
items.translation: 用于为实体实例创建自链接的组件。
